title: pilot-capacity-playbook-and-early-adopter-kpi-atlas
content:
Overview:
This is a compact, tactical playbook + KPI atlas intended for the first 30–90 day pilot (early-adopter cohort). Focus: capacity posture, ramp schedule, KPI guardrails, and concrete fallback actions. Use this as both a tracker (sheet) and a one-page runbook for on-call + ops lead during launch windows.

Goals:
- Validate dedicated-routing throughput and KV cache benefits at traffic scale 1k–50k requests/day.
- Keep 95th percentile latency under target SLO while testing batch/caching knobs.
- Protect unit economics: per-token cost delta vs baseline < 30% during pilot.

Quick reference table (row per initiative) -- treat as spreadsheet rows:
Initiative | Owner | Start | End | Readiness | SLO target | Current metric | Burn / Trend | Contingency (action)
Model Pin & Canary | Marco Chen | 2025-11-10 | 2026-01-15 | amber | p95 < 220ms | p95 240ms | +8% | roll back to v1.2 quantized; enable prefix cache
Traffic Phasing | Priya Singh | 2025-11-15 | 2026-02-01 | green | 10–1000 rps | avg 120 rps | stable | throttle at 60% if GPU queue > 80%
Cost Telemetry | Aisha Kapoor | 2025-11-01 | 2026-03-01 | green | cost/<k tokens < $0.85 | $0.78 | improving | enable batching hints; reduce max tokens to 256 for non-critical calls
Eval Regression Watch | Lena Thompson | 2025-11-20 | 2026-02-28 | in_review | >95% pass on golden prompts | 97% | flat | auto-fallback to higher-quality checkpoint when score < 92%
Support Runbook | Oncall Rotation | 2025-11-10 | ongoing | green | MTTR < 45m | MTTR 26m | improving | escalate to infra-oncall; open incident channel #pilot-response

Readiness checklist (action items; tickbox style):
- [x] Capacity sizing calc (GPU nodes + spare) — baseline: 6 A100 equiv nodes + 2 spare
- [x] Perf benchmark PR merged (load harness + CSV artifacts)
- [ ] Observability: per-route cost + token histogram dashboard (owner: Observability)
- [x] Canary config and rollout policy (canary interval: 15 min, scale: 5% -> 50%)
- [ ] Customer comms template (legal review pending)
- [x] Data path audit + KMS integration validated

Early-adopter cohort plan (staggered ingress):
Day 0–7: 1–3 customers, 1% traffic each; manual monitoring window 12h/day
Day 8–21: expand to 8 customers; 5% traffic each; enable autoscaling from min=4 -> max=20 nodes
Day 22–45: open to full cohort (20–50 customers); target combined traffic 20k rps peak, but ramp only if p95 < SLO for 48h
Pause thresholds (immediate hold if any met):
- p95 latency sustained > SLO for 30 minutes AND GPU queue length > 70%
- Error rate > 2% for 15 minutes
- Cost-per-1000-tokens exceeds 40% above baseline for two consecutive days

KPI baseline + target cells (tracked daily):
- Requests/day (target ramp): [1k -> 50k] (owner: Priya)
- p50/p95/p99 latency (ms) (owner: Marco)
- Model quality eval score (golden set) (owner: Lena)
- Tokens/day & token-split (prompt vs completion) (owner: Aisha)
- Cost per 1k tokens (USD) (finance tag)
- MTTR (minutes) for incidents during pilot (SRE owner)

Backstop strategies (tiered):
1) Soft fallback: reduce max output tokens to cap cost spikes; enable KV prefix cache for repeated prompts
2) Model variant fallback: route to smaller quantized model (v1-lite) for non-critical endpoints when latency spike detected
3) Regional failover: shift traffic to secondary region (note: cold-start risk)
4) Full throttle & hold: pause new sessions, keep existing sessions running until operators clear backlog

Simulated runway (notes from capacity sim):
- Estimated tokens/day at 10k req/day with avg 150 tokens = 1.5M tokens/day; GPU throughput estimate: 6 nodes saturate at ~3M tokens/day with current kernel config
- Buffer target: keep spare capacity to absorb 30% burst (plan: +2 hot nodes, +1 warm node)
- If queue length > 1.2s average, trigger canary rollback and open incident phone bridge

Ownership & escalation map (short):
- Product Ops lead: Aisha Kapoor — go/no-go authority for cohort expansion
- Infra/Serving lead: Marco Chen — responsible for kernel/runtime changes
- Eval/Quality: Lena Thompson — approves golden set regression tolerances
- Finance signal: Emma Alvarez (stake) — signoff required if projected cost delta > budget line

Open questions / notes to self:
- Confirm retention window on detailed token billing export (need 90 days for root cause) — ticket created JIRA-3921
- Do we want granular per-token cost alerting on channel #fin-alarms? (Priya to propose threshold)
- Consider a small experimental pre-warming pool for rapid regional failover (cost vs TTL tradeoff)

Appendix: Mini CSV for quick paste into monitoring (headers + one sample row):
date,requests,total_tokens,p50_ms,p95_ms,error_rate,cost_per_1k_tokens
2026-02-19,12430,1864500,72,198,0.6,0.79

Concluding note: Keep this doc as the single source-of-truth for pilot ramp decisions. If anything in the sheet diverges from Confluence runbook, escalate immediately to product-ops.

(End of sheet)
